t: L-PRO All Purpose Non-Woven Blue Cleaning Cloths are designed for efficient and versatile cleaning across various environments. These highly absorbent and durable cloths are suitable for all hard surfaces, making them ideal for workshops, construction sites, or general maintenance tasks. Each soft, pre-cut 30cm x 38cm cloth can be used wet or dry, offering flexibility for different cleaning requirements. They are quick drying and can be used as single-use disposable cloths or washed by hand for repeated use, providing a practical solution for trade professionals. The blue colour also assists with colour-coded cleaning systems.
b: Use Dry or Wet for Flexible Cleaning
